name: Taiwan Hon Chuan Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Hon Chuan Enterprise Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various packaging materials for the food and beverage industries in Taiwan, Mainland China, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company offers plastic caps, preforms, PET bottles, labels, claw caps, and aluminum caps, and other products; and LDPE shrink films. It also provides beverage filling contract manufacturing; and packaging and filling services, as well as involved in international investment business. The company was formerly known as Hon Chuan Metal Development Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Taiwan Hon Chuan Enterprise Co., Ltd. in 1999.
